title: Reinspection Charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage
content:
## What the charge is

Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, a crack item that was denied as within tolerance can be reported again; when the re-measurement of that re-reported item again finds it within tolerance, the visit may carry a reinspection charge to the homeowner. The reinspection charge is worked out on the day it is assessed and is linked to the claim item of the re-measured crack. Once booked, it appears with its own charge number on the homeowner's warranty invoice and in the coverage's charge history, and its amount is added to the warranty charges the homeowner owes on that coverage.

## Booking the charge

Tool: `assess_reinspection_charge_a99ab20e`, an agent-side tool. The desk agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books one reinspection charge, dated the day of the call, on a re-reported crack item that the re-measurement found within tolerance again.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's warranty coverage on the home, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup for this homeowner | Identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `claim_item_ref` | The service request item number of the re-reported crack item that was re-measured | Copied character for character, digits and hyphens included, exactly as shown in the coverage's warranty history, with no reformatting |
| `amount` | The charge amount in US dollars | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; no currency sign or thousands separator |

## What the call returns

A receipt whose `status` is `charge_booked` means the charge is on the coverage. It also carries `warranty_event_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `charge_reference` (the charge number printed on the homeowner invoice, text such as WCH-51234), `coverage_id` (the coverage charged), `claim_item_ref` (the item the charge is linked to), `charge_type` (always `reinspection_fee`), `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the assessment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `charges_due` (the homeowner's warranty charges owed on the coverage including this charge, US dollars, 2 decimal places).

**Illustrative call (hypothetical values).** `coverage_id` WC-000456, `claim_item_ref` WSR-31002-02, `amount` 64.00 returns `status` `charge_booked` with `charge_type` `reinspection_fee`.
